boundary: PASS demonstrates a bounded anti-false-certainty provenance-topology guard. Distinct caller-supplied provenance identities with opposing qualifying relation signals remain CONTESTED_BY_RECEIPTS. Opposing signals under one canonical provenance identity are kept open and audited rather than counted as independent evidence. Provenance identity remains metadata, not proof of real-world source independence or source quality.
